row:
Valiant Veterinary Physiotherapy is a specialist small animal rehabilitation and fitness centre based in Melton Mowbray.

A series of physiotherapy videos showing exercises, workouts and mental enrichment ideas for your dog(s).

Find us at www.vvphysiotherapy.co.uk or follow us Facebook, Instagram and Twitter.
